headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $80,000 as Buying Pauses and Fed Caution Weighs
summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as Strategy paused cryptocurrency purchases and investor caution surrounding Federal Reserve interest rate policy persisted.
why: Bitcoin is the flagship digital asset whose price movements influence overall crypto market liquidity and speculative sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: A pause in treasury purchases and broader central bank policy caution dampened demand.

why_moved: Reduced institutional buying activity combined with macroeconomic caution triggered selling pressure in digital assets.
